messages:
anika: kicking off a focused thread on pilot thresholds for the new commit-smoothing product. goal: pick conservative pilot defaults and a clear migration/sunset path for burst credits.
ben: +1. sales need guardrails that don't blow up ops. propose default pilot band = +25% smoothing, trialable to +50% for 30 days.
lena: sales: default +25% ok for small-mid customers. bigger accounts might ask for +100% which we should gate behind capacity review.
marco: infra notes: to support this we need per-account 30d rolling usage, peak-day multiplier, and a short-circuit when usage > 3x typical. estimate: one infra sprint for metrics, one for throttles.
jesse: cs perspective: pilot customers want simple UX. show two things in console: remaining smoothing allowance and projected end-of-window overcommit risk.
anika: billing behavior during pilot: 1) consume pre-paid credits up to smoothing cap; 2) if exceeded, auto-bill overage at agreed rate but flag account; 3) after 3 months of repeated exceedances, open renewal conversation.
ben: legal asked for explicit "abuse" definition. propose: >2 months out of 6 where smoothing exceeded by >50% triggers remediation.
lena: also propose a migration path: customers on burst credits can opt-in, get pro-rated credit conversion, and have 90d notice before we sunset burst credits. that avoids surprises.
marco: operational safety: add a soft-throttle at 1.5x budget and a hard-throttle at 3x until manual review. avoids noisy neighbors.
anika: KPIs for pilot: number of accounts in pilot, % that exceed smoothing, avg overage $ per account, incident count due to throttles, conversion rate to paid band.
jesse: recommend 3 pilot logos: two mid-market SaaS (prod-heavy), one AI-native startup (spiky). ben/lena to confirm.
ben: agreed. I'll line up names. also sales wants a 30d trial bump to test flexible band in negotiation.
lena: pricing math note: band uplift should be roughly +8-12% unit price for +25% smoothing, +20% for +50%, and +40% for +100%. numbers rough, needs finance model.
anika: UX copy for console tooltip:
Commit smoothing lets you buffer short spikes by allowing usage above your monthly commit. The smoothing window is 30 days. Each band sets how much headroom you get and the uplift on unit price. Exceeding your band may lead to overage billing or a migration ask.
marco: tickets to create: PRIC-SMOOTH-101 (billing hooks), PRIC-SMOOTH-102 (metrics & throttles), PRIC-SMOOTH-103 (console UI + tooltips), PRIC-SMOOTH-104 (legal terms + abuse rule).
ben: risks: cannibalization of burst credits, confusion at renewals, and capacity planning headaches. mitigation: migration doc, sunset timeline, and capacity quota reserve for pilot customers.
lena: roadmap impact: deprioritize new burst-credit features for Q2, focus on smoothing rollout + migration. call out internal comms to CS/sales/finance.
anika: launch readiness checklist (pilot MVP):
- billing: apply smoothing window and overage rules (yes/no)
- infra: per-account rolling metric + throttles
- console: smoothing allowance + warning banners
- legal: pilot T&Cs + abuse clause
- sales enablement: one-pager + sample contract language
- cs: migration FAQ + pro-ration formula

marco: ETA: 6w for pilot MVP if we get sign-off this week.
jesse: i'll draft migration FAQ and customer email templates.
anika: next steps: ben/lena pick pilot customers by Fri, marco to confirm ETA, i'll loop in finance/legal. @pricing-bot create epic PRIC-SMOOTH. :rocket:
pricing-bot: Epic PRIC-SMOOTH created (https://go/repo/PRIC-SMOOTH) - owners: anika, marco, ben.
